# Prompt: Hallmark Study Bridge

## Objective
Extract visual DNA from a reference and convert it into governed UX artifacts.

## Prompt
```text
Usa Hallmark en modo study sobre esta referencia visual y luego:
1) resume macroestructura/tipografia/color,
2) @design-system-architect normaliza a tokens,
3) @ux-ui-expert valida WCAG AA y consistencia.
```

## Expected Output
- Visual DNA summary.
- Token normalization proposal.
- UX governance validation with risks and fixes.
